paragraphs: The F-Pace P250 has been part of the Jaguar SUV range since the model's launch in 2016. It uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine, part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular Ingenium family introduced in 2015. The P250 represents the highest-output 2.0-litre petrol variant in the F-Pace line-up, positioned between the discontinued P340 V6 and the P400 six-cylinder above it. It remains a current variant across the X761 generation. Jaguar F-Pace P250 Engine Compatibility Because the F-Pace P250 uses a single consistent engine family across its production run, compatibility confirmation is straightforward — but still essential before any rebuild or replacement begins. You get back a near-new engine with a 12-month warranty, without the compatibility risk of a used unit. Reconditioned F-Pace P250 Engines "Reconditioned" is often used interchangeably with "rebuilt" — it means restoring your engine to full working condition rather than replacing it. Our rebuild service delivers exactly that. Refurbished F-Pace P250 Engines "Refurbished" typically describes the same process from a different angle — your existing engine is restored rather than swapped. Our rebuild covers this. Remanufactured F-Pace P250 Engines A remanufactured engine is rebuilt to original specification with updated components where available. This is consistent with what our rebuild service delivers on the Ingenium AJ200P. However, used engines carry unknown history — most owners who ask about used units choose a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the F-Pace P250 from 2023 to present. The Ingenium AJ200P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ200P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ200P rebuild.
